conclusion: input.type = 'date' fell back to a plain text field: the digits were accepted as raw text and no segmented date editor appeared. InputType::create() gates each type behind a runtime setting (Settings::inputTypeDateEnabled, inputTypeColorEnabled, ...) and an unsupported type silently stays 'text', so BaseDateAndTimeInputType is never instantiated on this port.
effect_on_candidate: date-input UAF (869d5c55 / 310544) is UNREACHABLE on 14.10 - not because of the UA shadow root, but because the input type does not exist here. Candidate closed.
worth_keeping: a USB keyboard does deliver trusted keydowns into the Guide WebView, which is a capability several bug classes need
next: poc-input-types.js maps which input types survive InputType::create(), so the form-control surface can be audited from facts rather than assumptions
